selection_rules: One Boss Blind is chosen per ante (when the ante begins); it is shown in advance and can be rerolled with Director's Cut (once per ante, $10), Retcon (unlimited, $10 each) or the Boss Tag.
If ante is a multiple of 8 (8, 16, 24, 32) only Showdown bosses are eligible; otherwise only regular bosses whose min_ante <= max(1, ante).
Antes <= 0 are treated as ante 1 for the min_ante check (8 bosses eligible at ante 1: Hook, Club, Psychic, Goad, Window, Manacle, Pillar, Head).

Among eligible bosses, only those used the FEWEST times so far this run can be picked (uniform random among them). Rerolled-away bosses count as used. So no boss repeats until every eligible one has appeared.
Rerolling on a multiple-of-8 ante always yields another Showdown boss; elsewhere a regular boss.
Hieroglyph/Petroglyph do not re-pick the current boss (it may then sit below its min ante); rerolling fixes that.
Hands that violate a boss restriction (Psychic, Mouth, Eye) can still be played but score 0 and trigger no scoring effects ('Not allowed!').
disable: Chicot (disables every boss on blind select) and Luchador (sell to disable current boss) remove the boss effect; The Wall/Violet Vessel requirement returns to 2x base, The Needle stays 1x, The Water/Needle/Manacle restore discards/hands/hand size.

bosses.name: The Hook
bosses.effect: After each hand is played, 2 random cards still held in hand are discarded.
bosses.short: Discards 2 random held cards after each hand
details: Happens when Play is pressed, BEFORE scoring, so those cards do not give held-in-hand effects (inferred from Steel cards page + Balatro-Simulation press_play order).
Discarded cards trigger discard effects for jokers.

bosses.name: The Club
bosses.effect: All Club cards are debuffed.
details: Wild cards count as all suits and are debuffed too.

bosses.name: The Psychic
bosses.effect: A played hand must contain exactly 5 cards; otherwise it scores nothing ('Not allowed').
bosses.short: A hand must have exactly 5 cards to score

bosses.name: The Goad
bosses.effect: All Spade cards are debuffed.

bosses.name: The Window
bosses.effect: All Diamond cards are debuffed.

bosses.name: The Manacle
bosses.effect: -1 hand size for this round.
bosses.short: -1 hand size this round

bosses.name: The Pillar
bosses.effect: Cards already played earlier in this ante (during its Small/Big Blind) are debuffed.
bosses.short: Cards played this ante are debuffed

bosses.name: The Head
bosses.effect: All Heart cards are debuffed.

bosses.name: The Arm
bosses.effect: Each played hand loses 1 level permanently, applied before it scores (no effect at level 1).
bosses.short: Each hand played loses a level
details: Levels lost stay lost after the round.

bosses.name: The Fish
bosses.effect: Cards drawn after each played hand come in face down.
bosses.short: Cards drawn after a hand come face down

bosses.name: The Flint
bosses.effect: The hand's base chips and base mult (from its level) are halved before card scoring.
bosses.short: Base chips and mult are halved
details: Rounding: chips = max(0, floor(chips/2 + 0.5)), mult = max(1, floor(mult/2 + 0.5)) (i.e. halves round up: High Card 5x1 -> 3x1).
Applied after 'before/on played' joker effects such as Space Joker level-ups (Balatro-Simulation order; wiki lists it under 'boss effects' at step 1).

bosses.name: The House
bosses.effect: The first hand of the round is dealt face down.
bosses.short: The first hand is dealt face down

bosses.name: The Mark
bosses.effect: All face cards are drawn face down.

bosses.name: The Mouth
bosses.effect: Only the first hand type played this round may be scored; any other hand type scores nothing.
bosses.short: Only the round's first hand type scores

bosses.name: The Needle
bosses.effect: You get only 1 hand this round.
details: Requirement is only 1x base. If disabled, hands are restored but the requirement stays 1x.

bosses.name: The Wall
bosses.effect: Extra large blind: requirement is 4x base.
bosses.short: Extra large blind

bosses.name: The Water
bosses.effect: Start the round with 0 discards.

bosses.name: The Wheel
bosses.effect: Each card drawn has a 1 in 7 chance to be face down.
bosses.short: 1 in 7 cards drawn come face down
details: Listed probability: Oops! All 6s makes it 2 in 7.

bosses.name: The Eye
bosses.effect: Each hand type may be scored only once this round; repeats score nothing.
bosses.short: Each hand type scores only once this round

bosses.name: The Tooth
bosses.effect: Lose $1 for every card played (scoring or not); can push money below $0.
bosses.short: Lose $1 for every card played
details: Charged when Play is pressed, before scoring.

bosses.name: The Plant
bosses.effect: All face cards (J, Q, K, and everything with Pareidolia) are debuffed.
bosses.short: All face cards are debuffed

bosses.name: The Serpent
bosses.effect: After every play or discard, always draw exactly 3 cards (regardless of how many were used).
bosses.short: Always draw 3 cards after a play or discard

bosses.name: The Ox
bosses.effect: Playing the run's most played poker hand sets your money to $0.
bosses.short: Playing the most played hand sets money to $0
details: 'Most played hand' is fixed when the ante starts; ties broken randomly (wiki marks tie rule as needing verification).
Only the played hand type counts (a Straight Flush does not trigger it when the most played hand is Straight).

bosses.name: Amber Acorn
bosses.effect: Flips all jokers face down and shuffles their order.
bosses.short: Flips and shuffles all jokers

bosses.name: Verdant Leaf
bosses.effect: All playing cards are debuffed until 1 Joker is sold.
bosses.short: All cards debuffed until a Joker is sold

bosses.name: Violet Vessel
bosses.effect: Very large blind: requirement is 6x base.
bosses.short: Very large blind

bosses.name: Crimson Heart
bosses.effect: Each hand, one random joker is disabled (debuffed); never the same joker twice in a row unless it is the only one.
bosses.short: One random joker is disabled each hand
details: Jokers already debuffed are not chosen. The joker disabled on the winning hand stays disabled until the next shop (misses end-of-round effects).

bosses.name: Cerulean Bell
bosses.effect: One random card in hand is always force-selected; a new one is chosen after each play/discard if needed.
bosses.short: One random card is always selected
